limits: No live IAM/CMK/endpoint/service authorization proof; permission requirements reviewed from official API contracts.

SPECS uses real DescribeStacks solely as existing planner descriptor for this multi-service kind. Native receipt service/operation identifies actual read. Coordinator action planning must use selected surfaces and must not infer CloudFormation-only permissions from this descriptor.
Native matrix exercises us-east-1/aws; conservative China/GovCloud parsing and host rules are code-reviewed, not independently regional native matrix proof.
SDK allocates whole responses before projection: byte limits are inspection/retention, not a streaming memory guarantee.
No exhaustive service/runtime/history coverage; exact unsupported surfaces listed individually. No secret-store payload, execution, invocation, write or credential validity test.
Detection is supported signatures over selected bytes; arbitrary encodings, encryption, unreturned values and YAML escaped-scalar decoding are not exhaustive.
No repeated consistency read for mutable configurations; result is one authenticated returned configuration, not atomic state over time.
New code remains local and unregistered pending coordinator atomic admission; existing pattern-only IDs retain original semantics.
